entities.name: Mabel's party
entities.description: Party of misfit heroes led by Mabel, formed to repel the Calamity Beasts in Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Leader of the party; she fetched Cragflame from her attic and led the party to Pondside.

entities.name: Helga
entities.description: Party member who warned Mabel about the Calamity Beasts and has visions and augury.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: Member of Mabel's party.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: Member of Mabel's party who knew a shortcut across a dandelion field.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: Member of Mabel's party who kept the party afloat in the flood.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: Member of Mabel's party.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker in otterfolk form, looking for Jace Beleren; he fought the Storm Hawk alone.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Ral Zarek is looking for.

entities.name: Cragflame
entities.description: Item Mabel fetched from her attic.

entities.name: Maha
entities.description: Calamity Beast who destroyed Pondside and whose egg was stolen.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Monstrous beasts threatening Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Storm Hawk
entities.description: Animal-shifted dragon from another plane that stormed the dandelion fields and later the throne room; defeated by Maha.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: Weaselfolk who stole a calamity beast's egg on King Glarb's hire.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: Ruler at Fountainport who hired Cruelclaw to steal Maha's egg.

entities.name: Coffey
entities.description: Ratfolk superior who offered the party hospitality.

entities.name: Tucker
entities.description: Molefolk who led the party out of the tunnels.

entities.name: Pondside
entities.description: Settlement destroyed by Maha.

entities.name: Three Trees City
entities.description: City attacked by the Flood Gale.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: City where King Glarb holds his throne room.

entities.name: Goodhill
entities.description: Home of the party, where they were celebrated on return.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: Plane of animal-folk where the story takes place.

events.summary: The party forms after Helga warns Mabel about the Calamity Beasts; Mabel fetches Cragflame and resolves to go to Pondside.
events.quote: Mabel fetched Cragflame from her attic and announced that she would travel to Pondside

events.summary: At Pondside the party finds it destroyed by Maha, and defeats skeletons animated by squirrelfolk necromancers, who escape.
events.quote: they found that it was destroyed by Maha

events.summary: At Three Trees City the party meets Ral Zarek, who is looking for Jace; Helga sees Jace in a vision.
events.quote: Helga saw Jace in one of her visions

events.summary: The Flood Gale attacks Three Trees City; Hugs and Ral keep the party afloat.
events.quote: Hugs kept the party afloat, along with Ral Zarek.

events.summary: The party washes up in a ratfolk cavern and Coffey offers hospitality.
events.quote: stepped in and offered the party hospitality

events.summary: The party learns Cruelclaw stole a calamity beast's egg and resolves to return it.
events.quote: the party resolved to retrieve the egg and return it to its rightful place

events.summary: Helga's augury locates Cruelclaw and she draws a picture of Fountainport.
events.quote: Helga used her augury to locate Cruelclaw

events.summary: Tucker leads the party out of the tunnels to a marshland.
events.quote: A molefolk named Tucker led the party out of the tunnels to a marshland.

events.summary: Mabel decides to take the shortcut across the stormy dandelion field despite Tucker's warning.
events.quote: but Mabel decided to bring the party through the shortcut

events.summary: The Storm Hawk spots the party; Ral Zarek fights the dragon alone while the others hide.
events.quote: Ral Zarek told the others to run and fought the dragon alone

events.summary: At Fountainport King Glarb reveals he hired Cruelclaw to steal Maha's egg to raise it as a protector.
events.quote: King Glarb revealed that he had hired Cruelclaw to steal

events.summary: The party fights King Glarb and defeats Cruelclaw and his mercenaries; Maha arrives and defeats the Storm Hawk.
events.quote: Maha arrived and defeated the Storm Hawk

events.summary: Mabel returns Maha's egg and Maha ends her rampage and departs.
events.quote: Maha ceased her rampage and departed peacefully

events.summary: The party returns to Goodhill and is celebrated.

relations.quote: the party of misfit heroes led by Mabel
he had hired Cruelclaw to steal
